## Avatar

`import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage, AvatarStatus, PresenceDot } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

`size-8` by default; a caller resizing it sets the initials' size too.

Also takes: bits-ui `Avatar.Root` props.

### `AvatarFallback`

Renders while the image loads, and stays if it fails.

Also takes: bits-ui `Avatar.Fallback` props.

### `AvatarImage`

Also takes: bits-ui `Avatar.Image` props.

### `AvatarStatus`

An avatar with a `PresenceDot` on its edge while someone is here. It wraps an `Avatar` rather than sitting inside it: `Avatar` clips its children to a circle, and the dot has to overhang the edge to read as a badge.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `isOnline` (required) | `boolean` |  | Shows the dot: someone is here right now. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Read to screen readers while online, e.g. "Has this ticket open". |

Also takes: every `<span>` attribute.

### `PresenceDot`

The live "here now" mark: an 8px success dot, ringed in the card colour so it separates from whatever it sits on, with a ping so it reads as live rather than as a status colour. On its own so it can sit on any edge.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Read to screen readers, e.g. "Has this ticket open". |

Also takes: every `<span>` attribute.

## Badge

`import { Badge, badgeVariants } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

A short label on a row: a status, a tag, a count. Colour and shape are two props because they are two decisions. Whether a badge is a state (`soft`), a thing done (`solid`) or a tag (`outline`) is the composition's call; what that state is (`success`, `critical`) is the data's.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'solid' \| 'soft' \| 'outline'` | `'soft'` | `soft` is a state something is in. `solid` is a thing that was done, and shouts. `outline` is a tag: metadata the reader may want, not a state to act on. |
| `tone` | `'neutral' \| 'primary' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'critical'` | `'neutral'` |  |
| `count` | `boolean` | `false` | A number on its own: one digit draws a circle and more stretch it into a pill of the same height, so a column of counts keeps one silhouette. |
| `children` | `Snippet` |  |  |

Also takes: every `<a>` attribute.

Also exports: `badgeVariants`.

Types: `BadgeVariant` (`'solid' | 'soft' | 'outline'`).

## Board

`import { Board, BoardCard, BoardColumn } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

Columns of cards grouped by a status: a pipeline read across. Read-only; moving a card between columns is the deferred drag-and-drop work. The row scrolls sideways rather than squeezing its columns, because a card needs its width to say anything.

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

### `BoardCard`

One item in a column, on a card surface. With `href` it is a link to the item: its hover darkens the border rather than tinting the fill, because `--accent` is the active nav row and nothing else.

Also takes: every `<a>` attribute.

### `BoardColumn`

One lane of a board: a header naming the status, then its cards. A fixed width, so a wide board scrolls instead of squeezing every card to nothing. Pass no children for an empty column; wrap an `{#each}` in `{#if items.length}`, since an `{#each}` that renders nothing still counts as children.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` (required) | `string \| Snippet` |  |  |
| `count` | `number` |  | How many items the column holds, which may be more than it shows. |
| `tone` | `'neutral' \| 'primary' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'critical'` | `'neutral'` | The dot beside the title. Neutral unless the status means something. |
| `actions` | `Snippet` |  | Right of the title: a link to the full list, a menu. |
| `empty` | `string \| Snippet` | `'Nothing here'` | Shown when the column has no cards, so it never collapses to its header. |

Also takes: every HTML attribute except `title`.

Export actions behind one trigger. Each item shows only when the page wires it, so the menu never offers something that does nothing.

A multi-select facet, drawn as a select: a filled pill summarising the choice rather than a dashed "add filter" chip, since a row of five dashed outlines is noisier than the values it filters. One choice shows its name; more show a count.

The ⋯ at the end of a table row, and the menu it opens: a round, soft, neutral button whose hover dims its own chip, never `--accent`, which means the active nav row. The menu opens leftward (`align="end"`) to stay inside the table.

## DeltaBadge

`import { DeltaBadge } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

A period-over-period change, as a tinted pill.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` (required) | `number` |  | The change, signed. `2.4` renders `+2.4%`, `-2.4` renders `-2.4%`. |
| `unit` | `string` | `'%'` | Appended to the number. `%` for a rate, `x` for a multiple. |
| `prefix` | `string` | `''` | Ahead of the number, after the sign: `$` renders `+$1.25`. Pass `unit=""` with it, or the `%` default trails the figure. |
| `precision` | `number` | `1` | Decimal places. A delta is a direction, not a measurement; one is usually right. |
| `invert` | `boolean` | `false` | Set when falling is the good outcome: failed payments, time to fulfil, stock at risk. The arrow still follows the sign; only the colour flips. |
| `variant` | `'pill' \| 'plain'` | `'pill'` | `pill`, the default, is a tinted, self-contained badge, for beside a bare figure. `plain` drops the fill and padding, for inline in a muted sentence where a pill would compete with the text sharing its line. |

Also takes: every `<span>` attribute.

## IconChip

`import { IconChip, iconChipClassName, iconChipVariants } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

A glyph on a tinted tile: the leading mark of a fact, a heading, a tile, a row. `sm` by default because most chips sit beside a line of text; `md` and `lg` stand in open space. Neutral is muted ink on `--muted`: a chip takes a colour only when the thing it marks is in a state worth one.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'sm'` | `sm` 32px, `md` 40px, `lg` 48px. |
| `shape` | `'square' \| 'circle'` | `'square'` | `square` is a squircle whose radius steps with the size; `circle` is for a composition that has chosen it. The slot owns the shape, not what sits in it. |
| `tone` | `'neutral' \| 'primary' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'critical'` | `'neutral'` |  |

Also takes: every `<span>` attribute.

Also exports: `iconChipClassName`, `iconChipVariants`.

Types: `IconChipShape` (`'square' | 'circle'`).

`import { Item, ItemActions, ItemContent, ItemDescription, ItemFooter, ItemGroup, ItemHeader, ItemMedia, ItemSeparator, ItemTitle, itemMediaVariants, itemVariants } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

## MetricBar

`import { MetricBar, MetricRank } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

One measure, stated and then drawn. The figure is the answer and the bar is the context: a reader who wants the value should not estimate it from a length, and a reader comparing rows scans the bars, not the digits. So the figure sits on the label's line.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` (required) | `string \| Snippet` |  |  |
| `percent` (required) | `number` |  | How full the bar is, 0–100. Clamped: over 100 is a bug upstream. |
| `value` | `string \| number \| Snippet` |  | The figure the bar shows, at the label's right edge. |
| `description` | `string \| Snippet` |  | A muted line under the label. |
| `icon` | `Snippet` |  | A glyph in a `md` `IconChip` before the label: what the row is about. |
| `rank` | `number` |  | The row's place in a ranking, as a `MetricRank` before the label, for a list whose order is the point. Pass `icon` or `rank`, not both. |
| `trailing` | `string \| Snippet` |  | Beside the bar, on its line: `398 / 500 units`. The bar shortens to make room; a figure that qualifies the bar belongs on the bar's line. |
| `tone` | `'neutral' \| 'primary' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'critical'` | `'primary'` | The fill. `primary` by default; a status only where the reader should act. |

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

### `MetricRank`

A place in a ranking, `1`, `2`, `3`, in a small muted circle. Smaller than an `IconChip` on purpose: the number orders the rows, it is not what they are about.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rank` (required) | `number` |  |  |

Also takes: every `<span>` attribute.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` (required) | `MetricGridItem[]` |  |  |
| `columns` | `2 \| 3` | `3` | Columns at `md` and up; one below, where two cells side by side leave no room for a label and a bar. The caller picks it, knowing how many items there are: three columns and four items leaves an orphan. |

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

Types: `MetricGridItem`.

## MetricRow

`import { MetricRow } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

A subject, the figures that describe it, and one bar beneath them all.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `Snippet` |  | A glyph in a `md` `IconChip` before the label. |
| `rank` | `number` |  | A place in a ranking, as `MetricRank`. Pass `icon` or `rank`, not both. |
| `label` (required) | `string \| Snippet` |  |  |
| `description` | `string \| Snippet` |  | A muted line under the title. |
| `stats` | `MetricRowStat[]` |  | The figures along the top right, each under its own caption. |
| `percent` (required) | `number` |  | How full the bar is, 0–100. Clamped: over 100 is a bug upstream. |
| `tone` | `'neutral' \| 'primary' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'critical'` | `'primary'` |  |
| `trailing` | `string \| Snippet \| null` |  | Beside the bar: `398 / 500 units`. Inline, it takes a right-aligned slot with a floor width, so every row's bar starts and ends at the same x. `null` holds the slot empty; leave it out to give the slot up. |
| `barPlacement` | `'below' \| 'inline'` | `'below'` | `below`, the default, runs the bar the full width under the row, for a row whose bar belongs to no figure in particular. `inline` puts it before the figures at a fixed width, for one figure the bar is a picture of. |
| `hideBar` | `boolean` | `false` | Hides the bar, for a row with nothing to measure: an empty bar reads as a failure. |

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

Types: `MetricRowStat`.

## RadialStat

`import { RadialStat } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

A share, drawn as an arc with the figure inside it. A circle has an obvious whole, so the ring says "roughly a quarter" without the reader converting a length. Right for a handful of parts side by side; wrong for a list, where twenty rings are a wall of dials.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `percent` (required) | `number` |  | 0–100. Clamped: a share over 100 is a bug upstream, not a full ring plus. |
| `tone` | `'neutral' \| 'primary' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'critical'` | `'primary'` |  |
| `diameter` | `number` | `72` | Outer diameter in pixels; the stroke scales with it. `diameter`, not `size`, which across the package means `sm \| md \| lg`. |
| `thickness` | `'regular' \| 'thick'` | `'regular'` | Ring weight. `thick` for a ring that is the subject of its own card. |
| `children` | `Snippet` |  | Replaces the printed percentage: a count, or a short word. |
| `'aria-label'` | `string` |  | Read by assistive tech in place of the ring. |

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

Types: `RadialThickness` (`'regular' | 'thick'`).

## ReadinessChecklist

`import { ReadinessChecklist, ReadinessSummary, summariseReadiness } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

One row per requirement, answering "what does this page still need from me". Deliberately not wrapped in a card: it goes in an AsideCard on one page and a page body on another, and a component that brought its own surface would make the second impossible.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` (required) | `ReadinessItem[]` |  |  |
| `emptyMessage` | `string` | `'Nothing to check yet.'` | Shown when nothing is applicable: a server returning no rows. |
| `showRequirement` | `boolean` | `true` | Drops the "Required" / "Optional" tag from unmet rows, for a progress list (what a server is doing), where a queued step tagged Required in warning colour reads as a problem when it simply has not started. |
| `showDetail` | `'unmet' \| 'all'` | `'unmet'` | `unmet` shows a row's `detail` and `action` only while it is unmet; `all` shows the detail on met rows too, for a record of a check already made, where what was found matters as much as what passed. |

Also takes: every `<ul>` attribute except `children`.

### `ReadinessSummary`

The count, the bar, and one line naming what is missing: naming it beats reporting that something is.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` (required) | `ReadinessItem[]` |  |  |
| `ready` | `boolean` |  | Whether the thing is actually ready, when something other than this list decides. Omit it and readiness is "every required item met", the only authority a form has; pass it where a server owns the gate. |
| `readyMessage` | `string` | `'Everything required is done.'` |  |

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute except `children`.

Also exports: `summariseReadiness`.

Types: `ReadinessItem`, `ReadinessSeverity` (`'block' | 'warn'`), `ReadinessStatus` (`'met' | 'unmet' | 'pending' | 'not-applicable'`), `ReadinessSummaryData`.

## SegmentedBar

`import { SegmentedBar } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

A whole, divided into named parts. One bar rather than one per part, because the question is how the total splits.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `segments` (required) | `Segment[]` |  |  |
| `showShare` | `boolean` | `true` | Print each share inside its segment. Off when the bar heads a list below. |
| `showLabels` | `boolean` | `true` | Captions above the bar, each over the segment it names. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `'md'` |  |

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

Types: `Segment`, `SegmentedBarSize` (`'sm' | 'md'`).

## SegmentedCode

`import { SegmentedCode } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

A code to read off a screen and type in somewhere else, in joined boxes of a few characters each, so a key reads here in the same groups the device asks for it in. The operator reads a box, types a box.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` (required) | `string` |  | The code as issued (`66G6D-ME7021KJ6JBFN82MAWQA9VCV`). Hyphens and spaces are dropped before it is split, so the groups decide where it breaks. |
| `groups` (required) | `readonly number[]` |  | How many characters each box holds, left to right: `[5, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4]`. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` |  |

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute except `children`.

## Sparkline

`import { Sparkline } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

A figure's recent shape, drawn small enough to sit beside it. No axes, no grid, no tooltip, no labels: it answers "is that number climbing or falling" in the space of a word. Anything that invites closer reading belongs in a chart on its own card.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` (required) | `number[]` |  | The series, oldest first. Fewer than two points draws nothing. |
| `tone` | `'neutral' \| 'primary' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'critical'` | `'primary'` |  |
| `height` | `number` | `40` | Height in pixels. The width comes from whatever holds it. |
| `'aria-label'` | `string` |  | Read by assistive tech: the shape says nothing without it. |

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

## StatTile

`import { StatTile } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

The dashboard's headline number. One tile states one figure, and the rest qualifies it: a unit, a delta, a description, a sparkline, a few rows. The icon sits in a chip so the eye lands on the number, and colour is kept for tone; a tile merely reporting a total stays in ink.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` (required) | `string` |  | A short caption above the figure. |
| `value` (required) | `string \| number \| Snippet \| null` |  | The figure, already formatted: the package has no opinion about currencies or locales. `null` renders an em dash. |
| `unit` | `string \| Snippet` |  | What the figure is counted in: `orders`, `per order`. Its own small line under the figure, since beside it a delta and a visual made every tile in a row wrap at a different point. |
| `exactValue` | `string` |  | The unabbreviated figure, on hover: `$45,612.40` under `$45.6k`. |
| `icon` | `Snippet` |  |  |
| `hint` | `Snippet` |  | An explanation trigger after the label; it belongs to the caption it explains. |
| `tone` | `'neutral' \| 'primary' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'critical'` | `'neutral'` | Colours the figure only, never the chip or the card: "this figure has a direction", not "this is a problem". |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` |  |
| `surface` | `'card' \| 'inset'` | `'card'` |  |
| `iconShape` | `'square' \| 'circle'` | `'square'` | `square` by default. A chip holding a face or initials is a circle; for icon chips the screen picks, and every chip in the row takes the same one. |
| `description` | `string \| Snippet` |  | A muted line under the figure. |
| `delta` | `Snippet` |  | After the figure, on its line: a `DeltaBadge`, so `$45.6k ↗ +15.7%` reads as one statement. Dropped on error. |
| `action` | `Snippet` |  | Top right, on the label's line: a link out to what the figure summarises. Keep it short; the label is the one that wraps. |
| `visual` | `Snippet` |  | A shape beside the figure, a `Sparkline` usually. It takes half the row and yields: a long figure squeezes the shape, never the reverse. |
| `rows` | `StatRow[]` |  | Supporting facts under the figure, ruled off from it and from each other. |
| `footer` | `Snippet` |  | Below everything else: a bar, a total. |
| `iconPosition` | `'left' \| 'right'` | `'right'` | Right by default: the icon is ornament, so label, figure and description run straight down the left edge. Left for an icon that carries meaning. |
| `iconAlignment` | `'center' \| 'top'` | `'center'` |  |
| `iconTone` | `'neutral' \| 'primary' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'critical'` | `'neutral'` |  |
| `iconSize` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` |  |  |
| `applyToneToIcon` | `boolean` | `false` | Lets the chip follow `tone`, so one threshold colours both and the two cannot drift into an ink figure in a red chip. Off by default: a tinted chip beside a tinted figure says the same thing twice. Supersedes `iconTone`. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `error` | `boolean` | `false` |  |

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

Types: `StatIconAlignment` (`'center' | 'top'`), `StatIconSize` (`'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`), `StatRow`, `StatSize` (`'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`), `StatSurface` (`'card' | 'inset'`).

## Table

`import { Table, TableBody, TableCaption, TableCell, TableFooter, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow, TableSectionRow } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `compact` | `boolean` | `false` | Tightens every row, the head included. The default suits a listing, where a row is a click target; `compact` is for a table being read (line items, totals, a mapping preview), where the extra height pushes the summary off the card. |

Also takes: every `<table>` attribute.

### `TableBody`

The rows. The last row drops its rule; the table edge is enough.

Also takes: every `<thead>` attribute.

### `TableCaption`

A caption under the table.

Also takes: every HTML attribute.

### `TableCell`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `numeric` | `boolean` | `false` | Right-aligned with tabular figures, so a column of numbers lines up. |

Also takes: every `<td>` attribute.

### `TableFooter`

Totals, on a muted band under the body.

Also takes: every `<thead>` attribute.

### `TableHead`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `numeric` | `boolean` | `false` | Right-aligns the column. Pair it with `numeric` on the column's cells. |
| `strong` | `boolean` | `false` | For a header that names the things compared rather than labelling a column of values (the roles across a permission matrix): ink at body size instead of the muted caption. |

Also takes: every `<th>` attribute.

### `TableHeader`

The column labels, muted, ruled off from the body.

Also takes: every `<thead>` attribute.

### `TableRow`

One row. `data-state="selected"` tints it as the active nav row is tinted.

Also takes: every `<tr>` attribute.

### `TableSectionRow`

A heading row inside `TableBody` that names the group of rows under it (assets, income, expenses): one `th scope="colgroup"` across the table.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `colspan` | `number` |  |  |

Also takes: every `<tr>` attribute.

## Timeline

`import { Timeline, TimelineConnector, TimelineContent, TimelineDot, TimelineItem, TimelineSkeleton, TimelineTitle, timelineDotVariants } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

A list of events, newest first by convention, each a badge, a title and a body joined by a vertical rule.

Also takes: every `<ol>` attribute.

### `TimelineConnector`

The rule under a badge. Rendered by every item except the last. `min-h-6` keeps a visible run of line under a one-line body, so a short entry does not collapse the badge spacing.

Also takes: every `<hr>` attribute.

### `TimelineContent`

The body. `pb-5` is the gap between entries; it sits here rather than on the item so the connector, which shares the row, runs the full distance.

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

### `TimelineDot`

The badge. Renders whatever icon it is given, and a small filled circle when given nothing: an empty 32px disc reads as a component that failed to load.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | `'primary' \| 'neutral' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'critical'` |  |  |
| `indicator` | `Snippet` |  | A mark on the badge's lower-right edge (a `PresenceDot` while that entry's author is here now), drawn over the badge so the columns do not move. |

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

### `TimelineItem`

Also takes: every `<li>` attribute.

### `TimelineSkeleton`

A timeline's loading state: neutral pulsing badges and bars in place of text.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | `number` | `3` | How many placeholder entries. |

Also takes: everything `Timeline` takes except `children`.

### `TimelineTitle`

The row's heading. A `div`, not a `p`: the slot takes any children, a `Skeleton` among them, and a block inside a paragraph is invalid HTML.

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

Also exports: `timelineDotVariants`.

Types: `TimelineDotTone` (`'primary' | 'neutral' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'critical'`).

## TreeLeaf

`import { TreeLeaf } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

One row of a nested list: a stem down its left edge, an elbow into the row, a media chip, a label, and an optional trailing figure.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `position` | `keyof typeof STEM_CLASS` | `'middle'` | `last` shortens the stem to half height, so it does not run past the final row. |
| `icon` (required) | `Snippet` |  |  |
| `label` (required) | `string \| Snippet` |  |  |
| `trailing` | `string \| Snippet` |  |  |
| `mediaSize` | `keyof typeof MEDIA_SIZE_CLASS` | `'md'` |  |

Also takes: every `<li>` attribute except `children`.
